paper.title: Pareto Frontier of Neural Quantum States: Scalable, Affordable, and Accurate Convolutional Backflow for Strongly Correlated Lattice Fermions
paper.authors: Yuntian Gu, Zeyao Han, Wenrui Li, Zhiyu Xiao, Tao Xiang, Mingpu Qin, Liwei Wang, Dingshun Lv

results.system_description: 16x16 square lattice, periodic in both directions; U/t = 8, t'/t = -0.2; 224 electrons (112 up, 112 down), 1/8 hole doping
results.method: Accurate convolutional ansatz for lattice electrons (ACE)
results.source_location: Table I, p. 8 (row ACE, column t' = -0.2, PBC)
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the ACE state on the 16 × 16 PBC cluster at U = 8, 1/8 hole doping, t' = -0.2; the ACE+GFMC row is a projected estimate and excluded.
results.notes: The table states that omitted statistical errors are smaller than the last displayed digit. Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it. Audit 2026-10-15: the energy token, original NQS attribution and variational status were checked, but the exact spin-sector assignment in benchmark_id was not independently confirmed from the cited paper. Curator confirmation is still required; this is not a fully verified exact-instance match.
